name: Michael Garrett
summary: Michael Garrett is a simple courier task linking trade in the Undercity with the Forsaken's flight network. After collecting supplies packed by Gordon Wendham in the Trade Quarter, you are directed to deliver the crate to the bat handler Michael Garrett to arrange aerial transport out toward the Sepulcher. It highlights how the Forsaken utilize trained vampire bats to connect their capital with outposts across Lordaeron.

sections.title: Supplying the Outposts
sections.body: Running a fledgeling kingdom carved out of the ruins of Lordaeron requires constant logistics. Outposts like the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest rely heavily on goods, munitions, and provisions moving out from the Undercity. Gordon Wendham packs the necessary field supplies into a single crate in the city's Trade Quarter, but carting freight by ground through blighted forests is both slow and vulnerable to ambush by Scourge remnants or wild beasts.

sections.title: Wings of the Forsaken
sections.body: To bypass the dangers on the roads, the Forsaken rely on captive vampire bats bred and maintained by skilled handlers. Michael Garrett oversees these winged beasts from his roost near the entrance of the Undercity. Delivering the cargo to him ensures the supplies can be strapped to a bat and flown directly over the hills to Silverpine, teaching new couriers how the capital coordinates with remote settlements.

faq.answer: Michael Garrett is the Undercity's bat handler, stationed in the upper terrace above the subterranean canals near the surface exit. He manages the flight network's vampire bats, arranging travel and air delivery between the Forsaken capital and allied flight masters throughout Lordaeron.
The crate contains vital provisions and field supplies gathered by Gordon Wendham in the Trade Quarter, earmarked specifically for the Forsaken forces stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why use bats instead of carts or horses?
faq.answer: The overland roads winding out of Tirisfal Glades into Silverpine Forest are fraught with hazards, including roaming Scourge beasts, hostile humans, and treacherous terrain. Flying routes overhead via trained giant bats are drastically faster and completely bypass ground ambushes.

faq.q: Where does the delivery go after Michael Garrett?
faq.answer: Once Michael Garrett receives Gordon's Crate, the cargo is prepped to fly by bat directly to the bat master stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, completing the logistics chain.

faq.q: Where can Michael Garrett be found in Undercity?
faq.answer: He is located on the upper terrace near the main entrance leading out toward the surface ruins of Lordaeron, where the cavernous ceilings open enough for flying mounts to take wing.

faq.q: Do you need to have visited the Sepulcher before doing this?
faq.answer: To ride a bat yourself alongside the delivery, you must have previously spoken with the flight handler at the Sepulcher to unlock the aerial route; otherwise, you will have to travel there by foot.

angles.text: Understanding the aerial supply line run by handlers like Michael Garrett is essential for maintaining Sylvanas's presence beyond Tirisfal Glades.
For travelers arriving from Kalimdor, the Forsaken bat network serves as the primary mode of rapid transit across the northern Eastern Kingdoms.
